entries.definitionCN: 一起运作的一组相连部分。framework 是系统的结构，而不是运作中的系统。

entries.definition: advice or rules about how to act. They may sit inside a framework, but they are more specific and less structural.
entries.definitionCN: 关于如何行动的建议或规则。它们可以位于框架之内，但更具体，结构性更弱。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real frame + work compound and the real history of frame.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 frame + work 复合结构，以及 frame 的真实历史。

normal.en: Framework is frame + work: the frame is the part that does the supporting work.
normal.cn: framework 是 frame + work：frame 就是承担支撑工作的部分。

normal.en: In a building, the frame goes up first; in research, the framework of concepts goes down first.
normal.cn: 建筑先立框架；研究先搭概念框架。

normal.en: A legal framework is a skeleton of rules on which specific decisions hang.
normal.cn: 法律框架就是规则骨架，具体决定挂在上面。

normal.en: A software framework supplies the skeleton and calls your code at fixed points.
normal.cn: 软件框架提供骨架，并在固定位置调用你的代码。

normal.en: A story frame is a picture frame made of another story.
normal.cn: 故事框架就是用另一个故事做成的画框。

abstract.en: Picture scaffolding around a building not yet finished: it is not the building, but nothing can be built without it.
abstract.cn: 想象尚未完工的建筑外的脚手架：它不是建筑本身，但没有它什么也建不起来。

abstract.en: Picture a wire skeleton on which clay is shaped: the frame decides where the material can go.
abstract.cn: 想象塑造黏土用的铁丝骨架：骨架决定了材料能往哪里延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a picture frame: it does not paint anything, yet it decides what counts as inside the picture.
abstract.cn: 想象一个画框：它不画任何东西，却决定了什么算在画内。

examples.en: The report sets out a framework for future negotiations.
examples.cn: 这份报告为未来谈判提出了一个框架。

examples.en: Teachers need a clear framework for assessing writing.
examples.cn: 教师需要一个清晰的写作评估框架。

examples.en: The bridge's steel framework was completed before the surface was laid.
examples.cn: 桥的钢架在铺面之前就已完工。

dict_mnemonic.text: “弗瑞姆沃克”——弗瑞姆先走一圈搭好架子再干活 → framework 框架

root: 英语 frame“框架、骨架”+ work“工作、制品”，字面是“起支撑作用的构架”，引申为“体系、基本结构”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of framework all name a skeleton that is set up before the contents are added: beams, ideas, rules, code, roles, or stories.
sensesIntro.cn: framework 的八个义项都指在内容加入之前先搭好的骨架：梁、观念、规则、代码、角色或故事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a skeleton is erected first, and everything else is attached to it.
core.cn: 核心意象：先立起骨架，其余一切再附着其上。

branches.en: PHYSICAL: beams, steel, and scaffolding carry or enclose a building before the surface exists.
branches.cn: 物理：梁、钢、脚手架在表面存在之前承载或围合建筑。

branches.en: IDEAS: a theory or research study needs an arrangement of concepts before evidence fits in.
branches.cn: 观念：理论或研究需要先安排概念，证据才能放进去。

branches.en: RULES: a legal or political framework is the skeleton within which decisions are made.
branches.cn: 规则：法律或政治框架是决策在其中进行的骨架。

branches.en: SYSTEMS: software and organizations are built on reusable structures of code or roles.
branches.cn: 系统：软件和组织建立在可复用的代码或角色结构上。

branches.en: STORY: an outer narrative frames an inner one, as a picture frame holds a picture.
branches.cn: 故事：外层叙事框住内层叙事，正如画框承托画作。

intro.en: Framework is a native English compound, not a Latin derivation. Its parts are frame and work; the wider family adds -ed, -er, -ing, re- and compounds.
intro.cn: framework 是英语本族复合词，不是拉丁派生。它的成分是 frame 与 work；更大的词族加 -ed、-er、-ing、re- 和复合形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here. Frame is partly Scandinavian, and work is Germanic. This is a useful reminder that not every academic word is Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根。frame 部分来自斯堪的纳维亚语，work 是日耳曼语。这提醒我们：并非每个学术词都来自拉丁语。

items.meaning: a supporting structure or basic system
items.meaningCN: 框架；体系（frame“结构”+ work“制品”）
items.example: The framework is still being designed.
items.exampleCN: 框架仍在设计中。

items.structure: Middle English frame, partly Old Norse frami
items.meaning: a border or supporting structure; to shape or set up
items.meaningCN: 边框；框架；构建（中古英语 frame，部分来自古诺尔斯语 frami）
items.example: He built a wooden frame.
items.exampleCN: 他做了一个木框。

items.meaning: having a frame; or falsely accused
items.meaningCN: 有边框的；被构陷的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The photograph is framed in black.
items.exampleCN: 这张照片用黑色相框装裱。

items.meaning: a person who frames or drafts something
items.meaningCN: 构架者；制定者（-er 表示人）
items.example: The framers of the constitution met in secret.
items.exampleCN: 宪法的制定者秘密会面。

items.meaning: the act of building a frame or presenting an issue
items.meaningCN: 构建框架；取景；议题设定（-ing 构成名词）
items.example: The framing of the question shaped the answers.
items.exampleCN: 问题的表述方式影响了答案。

items.meaning: to frame again or present differently
items.meaningCN: 重新装框；重新表述（re-“再次”+ frame）
items.example: She reframed the problem as an opportunity.
items.exampleCN: 她把这个难题重新表述为机会。

items.meaning: a plot to make an innocent person appear guilty
items.meaningCN: 构陷；陷害（frame + up 复合名词）
items.example: The trial was a frame-up.
items.exampleCN: 那场审判是一场构陷。

items.meaning: a system of coordinates or assumptions used for judging
items.meaningCN: 参照系；判断框架（固定短语）
items.example: Each culture has its own frame of reference.
items.exampleCN: 每种文化都有自己的参照框架。

items.meaning: an agreement setting broad rules for later details
items.meaningCN: 框架协议（先定大原则、后定细节的协议）
items.example: They signed a framework agreement in June.
items.exampleCN: 他们在六月签署了框架协议。

definition_zh: 功能；作用；职能；函数；运转
definition_en: the purpose or role of something, a mathematical relationship, or to work and operate
core_image: 一台机器按既定职责运转
scene: 工程师把新装的心脏起搏器接上测试仪，旁边显示着心电波形。 The engineer tested the newly installed pacemaker and confirmed that its function is to steady the heartbeat, not to record data.
sceneCN: 这里 function 是「功能、作用」（第 1 个义项：某物的用途或职责）；句意：工程师测试了新装的心脏起搏器，确认它的功能是稳定心跳，而不是记录数据。

pos.zh: 功能；作用；职能；函数；典礼

derivatives.zh: 功能的；实用的；正常运作的

senses.title: The purpose or role of something
senses.definition: the purpose that a thing is designed to serve, or the role it plays
senses.definitionCN: 某物被设计要服务的目的，或它所扮演的角色
senses.example: The function of the heart is to pump blood.
senses.exampleCN: 心脏的功能是泵血。
senses.why: Latin functio is 'a performance, an execution', from fungi 'to perform, discharge'. A function is what a thing performs.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 functio 意为“执行、履行”，来自 fungi“执行、完成”。function 就是某物所执行的事。

senses.title: Verb: to work or operate
senses.definition: to work in the correct or expected way
senses.definitionCN: 以正确或预期的方式工作
senses.example: The machine functions without noise.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器运转时没有噪音。
senses.why: The verb appears in 1844 from the noun: to function is to perform one's proper work. 'Perform' is the core of fungi.
senses.whyCN: 动词在 1844 年由名词而来：to function 就是履行其应有的工作。“履行”正是 fungi 的核心。

senses.title: Mathematics: a function
senses.definition: a relation in which each input value has exactly one output value
senses.definitionCN: 每个输入值都恰好对应一个输出值的关系
senses.example: The area is a function of the radius.
senses.exampleCN: 面积是半径的函数。
senses.why: Leibniz introduced the mathematical use around 1692: one quantity 'performs' a determined value for each input, like a rule doing its work.
senses.whyCN: 莱布尼茨约在 1692 年引入数学用法：一个量对每个输入“履行”出确定的值，就像一条规则在完成工作。

senses.title: A formal ceremony or gathering
senses.definition: an official or formal social event, often with a ceremony
senses.definitionCN: 正式或官方的社交活动，常带仪式
senses.example: They attended a charity function.
senses.exampleCN: 他们参加了一场慈善活动。
senses.why: The sense 'official ceremony' is from the 1630s, originally in church use: the event is the public performance of a role.
senses.whyCN: “正式典礼”义始于 17 世纪 30 年代，最初用于教会：这种活动是某种角色的公开履行。

senses.title: A biological function
senses.definition: a normal activity of a living body or organ
senses.definitionCN: 生物体或器官的正常活动
senses.example: Sleep supports many bodily functions.
senses.exampleCN: 睡眠支持许多身体机能。
senses.why: An organ has a proper work to perform; when it performs it, the body lives. Medical usage keeps the 'proper performance' sense.
senses.whyCN: 器官有应履行的工作；它履行时，身体才存活。医学用法保留了“正确履行”的含义。

senses.title: A grammatical function
senses.definition: the role a word or phrase plays in a sentence, such as subject or object
senses.definitionCN: 词或短语在句中扮演的角色，如主语或宾语
senses.example: In this sentence, the clause functions as an adjective.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个句子里，这个从句起形容词的作用。
senses.why: Grammar asks what job a form performs in a sentence. The word's role is its function, not its shape.
senses.whyCN: 语法关心一个形式在句中执行什么工作。这个词的角色就是它的 function，而不是它的形状。

senses.title: Function as: serve as
senses.definition: to serve the purpose of something else, often temporarily
senses.definitionCN: 起到另一事物的作用，常为临时性的
senses.example: The corridor functions as a meeting room.
senses.exampleCN: 这条走廊被当作会议室使用。
senses.why: When an object performs a role it was not designed for, English says it 'functions as' that thing.
senses.whyCN: 当一个物件执行并非为其设计的角色时，英语说它 function as 那个东西。

senses.title: Computing: a subroutine
senses.definition: a named block of code that performs a specific task and can be called
senses.definitionCN: 执行特定任务、可被调用的具名代码块
senses.example: The function returns the total price.
senses.exampleCN: 这个函数返回总价。
senses.why: The computing sense is from 1947. A routine is a unit of work that is called to perform its task, exactly the old 'perform' idea.
senses.whyCN: 计算机义始于 1947 年。例程是一个被调用去完成任务的“工作单元”，正是古老的“履行”观念。

senses.title: A function of: depending on
senses.definition: in the phrase 'a function of', something that varies according to another factor
senses.definitionCN: 用于 a function of，表示随另一因素而变化的事物
senses.example: Success is a function of effort and timing.
senses.exampleCN: 成功取决于努力与时机。
senses.why: This extends the mathematical sense into ordinary speech: one thing's value is determined by another, as an output is determined by an input.
senses.whyCN: 这把数学义延伸到日常语言：一个事物的值由另一个事物决定，正如输出由输入决定。

intro.en: Function comes from Latin functio 'a performance', from fungi 'to perform'. It is not related to fundus or foundation, despite the similar sound in English.
intro.cn: function 来自拉丁语 functio“执行”，出自 fungi“履行”。它与 fundus 或 foundation 没有词源关系，尽管英语中读音相近。

items.en: First recorded as 'one's proper work or purpose; power of acting in a specific proper way', from French fonction and directly from Latin functionem.
items.cn: 最早记录为“一个人应有的工作或目的；以特定正当方式行动的能力”，来自法语 fonction，并直接来自拉丁语 functionem。

items.en: Latin functio (nominative) 'a performance, an execution' is a noun of action from funct-, the past-participle stem of fungi 'perform, execute, discharge'. PIE *bhung- 'be of use' is the suggested deeper source, with some uncertainty.
items.cn: 拉丁语 functio“执行、履行”是动作名词，来自 fungi“执行、完成、履行”的过去分词词干 funct-。其更早来源被认为是原始印欧语 *bhung-“有用”，但仍有一定不确定性。

items.en: The sense 'official ceremony' appears, originally in church use: a public performance of a role.
items.cn: “正式典礼”义出现，最初用于教会：某种角色的公开履行。

items.en: Leibniz begins the mathematical use of function. The verb 'perform a function' follows in 1844; the computing sense in 1947.
items.cn: 莱布尼茨在 1692 年开始数学上的 function 用法。动词“执行功能”在 1844 年出现；计算机义在 1947 年出现。

items.en: The family includes functional, functionary, malfunction, dysfunction and defunct, literally 'off-duty'. None of these comes from fundus.
items.cn: 词族包括 functional、functionary、malfunction、dysfunction、defunct，后者字面是“下班、不再履职”。这些词都不来自 fundus。

note.en: Look-alikes share fungi or sound; near meanings differ in whether they name a purpose, a job, or a working part.
note.cn: 形近词共享 fungi 或读音；近义词的区别在于指目的、职务还是运作部件。

entries.definition: relating to function; working properly; practical rather than decorative. It is function + -al.
entries.definitionCN: 与功能有关的；正常运作的；实用而非装饰的。它是 function + -al。

entries.definition: dead or no longer existing, literally 'off-duty'. It is de- 'off' + functus, the participle of fungi.
entries.definitionCN: 已死的；不复存在的，字面是“下班、卸职”。它是 de-“离开”+ fungi 的分词 functus。

entries.definition: a failure to work properly. It is mal- 'badly' + function.
entries.definitionCN: 故障；运转失灵。它是 mal-“不良”+ function。

entries.definition: basic or essential. It comes from fundus 'bottom', not from function, even though the two sound alike in English.
entries.definitionCN: 基本的；根本的。它来自 fundus“底部”，并非来自 function，尽管英语中两者读音相近。

entries.definition: the part a person or thing plays in a situation. It is close to function but often implies a script or expected part.
entries.definitionCN: 人或物在情境中扮演的部分。它与 function 接近，但常暗示某种既定脚本或预期角色。

entries.definition: the reason for which something exists or is done. It stresses intention, while function stresses the work actually performed.
entries.definitionCN: 某物存在或被做的理由。它强调意图，而 function 强调实际执行的工作。

entries.definition: a task or responsibility that a person must perform. It is more personal and obligatory than function.
entries.definitionCN: 人必须执行的任务或责任。它比 function 更个人化、更具义务性。

entries.definition: the act of working or being in effect. It matches function as a verb but is more often used of systems and machines.
entries.definitionCN: 运作或生效的行为。作动词义时与 function 对应，但更常用于系统和机器。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real fungi 'perform' family and the real modern technical senses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 fungi“履行”词族，以及真实的现代技术义项。

normal.en: fungi means 'perform': a function is the work a thing performs.
normal.cn: fungi 意为“履行”：function 就是某物所履行的工作。

normal.en: Defunct means 'off-duty': de- 'off' + functus 'having performed'. It is the same root as function.
normal.cn: defunct 意为“卸职”：de-“离开”+ functus“已履行”。它与 function 同根。

normal.en: A mathematical function performs one fixed output for each input, like a rule doing its job.
normal.cn: 数学函数对每个输入执行一个固定输出，就像规则完成本职工作。

normal.en: A formal function is a public 'performance' of a role, which is why the word means a ceremony.
normal.cn: 正式 function 是某种角色的公开“履行”，所以这个词也指典礼。

normal.en: Function as means the thing is temporarily performing another object's job.
normal.cn: function as 指某物临时执行另一个物件的职责。

abstract.en: Picture a key turning in a lock: the key's function is to open, and it performs that job every time.
abstract.cn: 想象钥匙在锁里转动：钥匙的功能是开锁，它每次都履行这项工作。

abstract.en: Picture a machine with a labeled dial for each task: every dial is one function the machine can perform.
abstract.cn: 想象一台机器每个任务都有一个标好的旋钮：每个旋钮就是机器能执行的一项 function。

abstract.en: Picture a person filling a role on stage: the part is the function, and the performance is functio.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人在台上扮演角色：角色是 function，演出就是 functio。

examples.en: The function of the filter is to remove dust from the air.
examples.cn: 过滤器的作用是去除空气中的灰尘。

examples.en: The old station now functions as a museum.
examples.cn: 老车站现在被当作博物馆使用。

examples.en: The software has a function that checks spelling.
examples.cn: 这款软件有一个检查拼写的函数。

dict_mnemonic.text: “方克身”——方块机器克尽职守地运转，各部件各干各的活 → function 功能、运转

root: 拉丁 fungi“执行、履行”→ functio“执行”，核心是“按职责运作、发挥应有的作用”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of function all describe a thing doing its proper work: an organ, a machine, a word, a ceremony, a code block, or a mathematical rule.
sensesIntro.cn: function 的九个义项都描述某物履行其应有工作：器官、机器、词语、典礼、代码块或数学规则。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a unit performs the job it is meant to do, and the job is also called its function.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个单元执行它应做的工作，而这项工作本身也叫它的 function。

branches.en: PURPOSE: an organ or device has a proper work that defines what it is for.
branches.cn: 目的：器官或装置有应做的工作，这定义了它的用途。

branches.en: OPERATION: to function is to work correctly, and to function as is to perform another thing's job.
branches.cn: 运作：to function 是正常运作，function as 是执行另一物件的职责。

branches.en: MATHEMATICS: an input determines an output, and ordinary life borrows this as 'depending on'.
branches.cn: 数学：输入决定输出，日常语言借用为“取决于”。

branches.en: CEREMONY: a formal event is a public performance of a social role.
branches.cn: 典礼：正式活动是社会角色的公开履行。

branches.en: LANGUAGE AND CODE: a word or a routine performs a specific job in a larger system.
branches.cn: 语言与代码：词或例程在更大系统中执行特定工作。

intro.en: Function is a Latin noun of action in -tio. English adds -al, -ally, -ary, and the prefixes mal- and dys- for failure.
intro.cn: function 是 -tio 拉丁动作名词。英语加 -al、-ally、-ary，并用前缀 mal-、dys- 表示失灵。

latinIntro.en: The base is fungi 'perform, discharge'; its participle functus gives function, defunct and perfunctory. Do not confuse this with fundus 'bottom', which gives foundation and fundamental.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 fungi“执行、履行”；其分词 functus 产生 function、defunct、perfunctory。不要与 fundus“底部”混淆，后者产生 foundation 和 fundamental。

items.meaning: the work a thing performs; to perform that work
items.meaningCN: 功能；执行功能（funct-“履行”+ -ion 动作名词）
items.example: The function of the liver is to filter blood.
items.exampleCN: 肝脏的功能是过滤血液。

items.meaning: relating to function; working; practical
items.meaningCN: 功能的；正常运作的；实用的（-al 构成形容词）
items.example: The design is simple but functional.
items.exampleCN: 这个设计简单但实用。

items.meaning: in terms of function
items.meaningCN: 在功能上（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The two systems are functionally identical.
items.exampleCN: 这两个系统在功能上完全相同。

items.meaning: a minor official
items.meaningCN: 官员；公务员（-ary 表示人）
items.example: A local functionary signed the form.
items.exampleCN: 一位地方官员签了表格。

items.meaning: a failure to work properly
items.meaningCN: 故障；运转失灵（mal-“不良”+ function）
items.example: A malfunction stopped the conveyor.
items.exampleCN: 一次故障使传送带停了下来。

items.meaning: abnormal or impaired functioning
items.meaningCN: 功能障碍；失调（dys-“不良、困难”+ function）
items.example: The illness causes kidney dysfunction.
items.exampleCN: 这种病导致肾功能障碍。

items.meaning: working normally; the act of operating
items.meaningCN: 正常运作的；运转（-ing 形式）
items.example: The system is functioning well.
items.exampleCN: 系统运转良好。

items.meaning: having no purpose or use
items.meaningCN: 无功能的；无用途的（-less 表示“没有”）
items.example: The old wing is functionless now.
items.exampleCN: 旧侧楼现在已无用途。

items.meaning: a word that expresses grammar rather than content
items.meaningCN: 功能词（表达语法关系而非实义的词）
items.example: Prepositions are function words.
items.exampleCN: 介词是功能词。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 执行；履行；完成（function 的词根）
执行；履行（英语 function 的直接来源）
已履行的；已卸职的（defunct 的来源）
已死的；已卸职的（英语 defunct 的来源）

definition_zh: 基本的；根本的；基础的；基本原理
definition_en: forming the base of something; essential, or the basic principles of a subject
core_image: 承载整座建筑的最底层石块
scene: 黑板上写着运算式，粉笔搁在课本旁。 The teacher reminded the students to master the fundamental rules of arithmetic before solving complex equations.
sceneCN: 这里 fundamental 是「基本的、根本的」（第 1 个义项：构成基础的、最根本的）；句意：老师提醒学生，先掌握基本运算规则，再去解复杂方程。

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）
最高级（更多用 most 构成）

derivatives.zh: 原教旨主义者；基要派的

senses.title: Basic and essential
senses.definition: forming the base of something and impossible to do without
senses.definitionCN: 构成某事物的基础，不可或缺
senses.example: Water is fundamental to life.
senses.exampleCN: 水对生命至关重要。
senses.why: Mid-15c. fundamental meant 'primary, original, pertaining to a foundation', modeled on Late Latin fundamentalis, from fundamentum 'foundation'.
senses.whyCN: 15 世纪中期的 fundamental 意为“首要的、本原的、与基础有关的”，仿照晚期拉丁语 fundamentalis，出自 fundamentum“基础”。

senses.title: Pertaining to a foundation
senses.definition: relating literally to the base on which a structure stands
senses.definitionCN: 字面上与建筑所立其上的底座有关
senses.example: The engineers checked the fundamental layer of the road.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师检查了道路的基层。
senses.why: The word keeps the literal image of fundamentum: the bottom layer on which everything rests.
senses.whyCN: 这个词保留了 fundamentum 的字面意象：承载一切的底层。

senses.title: Most important and central
senses.definition: of central importance to a matter, more than any detail
senses.definitionCN: 对某事务具有核心重要性，胜过任何细节
senses.example: Trust is fundamental to the partnership.
senses.exampleCN: 信任对这段合作关系至关重要。
senses.why: What is at the bottom supports everything above, so the bottom is also the most important. Importance follows from position.
senses.whyCN: 位于底部的东西支撑上方一切，因此底部也是最重要的。重要性来自位置。

senses.title: The fundamentals: basic principles
senses.definition: in the plural, the primary rules or skills of a subject
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指某学科的主要规则或基本技能
senses.example: You cannot skip the fundamentals of grammar.
senses.exampleCN: 你不能跳过语法基础。
senses.why: The noun use fundamentals, 'primary principles or rules', is from the 1630s. These are the parts on which the rest of the subject is built.
senses.whyCN: 名词用法 fundamentals“首要原则或规则”始于 17 世纪 30 年代。这些是学科其余部分所建立其上的部分。

senses.title: Music: the fundamental note
senses.definition: the lowest note of a chord or harmonic series, which supports the others
senses.definitionCN: 和弦或泛音列中最低的音，支撑其余的音
senses.example: The fundamental of the chord is low and steady.
senses.exampleCN: 这个和弦的基音低沉而稳定。
senses.why: Music uses the term from 1732: the lowest note is the base on which the harmonics are built.
senses.whyCN: 音乐从 1732 年起使用这个词：最低的音是泛音建立其上的基础。

senses.title: A fundamental right
senses.definition: a right treated as belonging to every person and not granted by ordinary law
senses.definitionCN: 被视为属于每个人、并非由普通法律授予的权利
senses.example: Free speech is a fundamental right in many countries.
senses.exampleCN: 言论自由在许多国家是一项基本权利。
senses.why: A right is called fundamental when it is placed at the base of the legal order, beneath ordinary legislation.
senses.whyCN: 当一项权利被置于法律秩序的底层、位于普通立法之下时，它就被称为 fundamental。

senses.title: A fundamental change
senses.definition: a change that affects the base of something, not just its surface
senses.definitionCN: 影响某事物基础、而不只是表面的变化
senses.example: The discovery caused a fundamental change in physics.
senses.exampleCN: 这一发现引起了物理学的根本性变化。
senses.why: If the base changes, everything built on it must change too. A fundamental change is therefore deeper than a superficial one.
senses.whyCN: 如果基础变了，建立其上的一切也必须改变。因此根本性变化比表面变化更深。

senses.title: A fundamental principle or law
senses.definition: a principle from which other rules or results are derived
senses.definitionCN: 其他规则或结果由之推导出来的原则
senses.example: Conservation of energy is a fundamental law.
senses.exampleCN: 能量守恒是一条基本定律。
senses.why: In science, a fundamental law sits at the base of a system: other statements are derived from it rather than the reverse.
senses.whyCN: 在科学中，基本定律位于体系的底层：其他陈述由它推导出来，而不是相反。

intro.en: Fundamental is modeled on Late Latin fundamentalis, from fundamentum 'foundation', from fundus 'bottom'. Its cousins include foundation, fund and profound.
intro.cn: fundamental 仿照晚期拉丁语 fundamentalis，出自 fundamentum“基础”，再出自 fundus“底部”。它的表亲包括 foundation、fund、profound。

items.en: First recorded as 'primary, original, pertaining to a foundation', modeled on Late Latin fundamentalis 'of the foundation'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“首要的、本原的、与基础有关的”，仿照晚期拉丁语 fundamentalis“基础的”。

items.en: Fundamentalis comes from Latin fundamentum 'a foundation, groundwork; support; beginning', from fundare 'to found', from fundus 'bottom, foundation'.
items.cn: fundamentalis 来自拉丁语 fundamentum“基础、地基；支撑；开端”，出自 fundare“奠基”，再出自 fundus“底部、基础”。

items.en: The noun fundament appears as 'foundation, base; buttocks, anus', from Old French fondement. The anatomical sense survives in English as a rare or humorous word.
items.cn: 名词 fundament 在 13 世纪晚期出现，义为“基础、底座；臀部、肛门”，来自古法语 fondement。解剖义在英语中作为罕见或幽默用法保留。

items.en: Fundamentals (n.) 'primary principles or rules' is from the 1630s. In music, from 1732, fundamental names the lowest note of a chord.
items.cn: fundamentals（名词）“首要原则或规则”始于 17 世纪 30 年代。音乐中从 1732 年起，fundamental 指和弦的最低音。

items.en: The family grows with fundamentally, fundamentalism and fundamentalist. Note again that function comes from fungi 'perform' and is not related.
items.cn: 词族扩展出 fundamentally、fundamentalism、fundamentalist。再次注意 function 来自 fungi“履行”，与这个词无关。

note.en: Look-alikes share fundus or sound; near meanings differ in whether they mean 'at the base', 'most important', or 'simple'.
note.cn: 形近词共享 fundus 或读音；近义词的区别在于指“在底部”“最重要”还是“简单”。

entries.definition: a base or an endowed institution. It is the noun whose adjective is foundational; fundamental is a parallel Latin formation.
entries.definitionCN: 地基或基金会。它是形容词 foundational 对应的名词；fundamental 则是平行的拉丁构词。

entries.definition: a base, literally the buttocks. It is the direct Latin noun, now rare in serious prose.
entries.definitionCN: 基础；字面指臀部。它是直接的拉丁名词，现在严肃写作中罕见。

entries.definition: money set aside, or to provide money. The financial branch of the same 'bottom' root.
entries.definitionCN: 留出的资金，或提供资金。同一个“底部”词根的金融分支。

entries.definition: a purpose or role. It comes from fungi 'perform', not from fundus, and only sounds similar.
entries.definitionCN: 功能；作用。它来自 fungi“履行”，不是来自 fundus，只是读音相近。

entries.definition: forming the simplest or lowest level. It is often about difficulty, while fundamental is about importance and depth.
entries.definitionCN: 构成最简单或最低层级。它常关乎难度，而 fundamental 关乎重要性与深度。

entries.definition: absolutely necessary. It stresses need, while fundamental stresses position at the base.
entries.definitionCN: 绝对必要的。它强调需要，而 fundamental 强调位于基础位置。

entries.definition: existing beneath the surface as a cause or support. It is spatial and often technical.
entries.definitionCN: 存在于表面之下，作为原因或支撑。它偏空间，常用于技术语境。

entries.definition: affecting the root or origin; far-reaching. It is stronger than fundamental in political contexts.
entries.definitionCN: 影响根源的；深远的。在政治语境中比 fundamental 更强。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real fundus / fundamentum family and the real musical and legal senses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的 fundus / fundamentum 词族，以及真实的音乐与法律义项。

normal.en: fundus means 'bottom': a fundamental rule is the bottom rule on which others stand.
normal.cn: fundus 意为“底部”：fundamental 规则就是其他规则立于其上的底层规则。

normal.en: Foundation, fund and fundamental are cousins, all from the same 'bottom' root.
normal.cn: foundation、fund、fundamental 是表亲，都来自同一个“底部”词根。

normal.en: In music, the fundamental is the lowest note, the base from which the chord is built.
normal.cn: 音乐中 fundamental 是最低的音，是和弦建立其上的基础。

normal.en: Fundamental rights sit beneath ordinary laws, which is why they are called basic.
normal.cn: 基本权利位于普通法律之下，所以被称为“基本的”。

normal.en: Function is not a cousin: it comes from fungi 'perform', despite the similar sound.
normal.cn: function 不是表亲：它来自 fungi“履行”，只是读音相近。

abstract.en: Picture the lowest stone in a wall: take it out and the wall falls, however solid the upper stones look.
abstract.cn: 想象墙里最底下的那块石头：抽掉它，墙就塌，无论上面的石头多坚固。

abstract.en: Picture a tree trunk holding up every branch: the trunk is fundamental, the branches are detail.
abstract.cn: 想象树干撑起所有枝条：树干是 fundamental，枝条是细节。

abstract.en: Picture the lowest note under a chord: remove it and the whole harmony loses its floor.
abstract.cn: 想象和弦下方最低的音：去掉它，整个和声就失去了地板。

examples.en: Clean water is fundamental to public health.
examples.cn: 清洁的水对公共健康至关重要。

examples.en: The course teaches the fundamentals of statistics.
examples.cn: 这门课教授统计学的基础。

examples.en: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
examples.cn: 这两种方法从根本上不同。

dict_mnemonic.text: “方得门头”——要进这扇门，先摸到门头下最底的那块基石 → fundamental 基本的

root: 拉丁 fundus“底部”→ fundamentum“基础”→ fundamentalis，核心是“位于最底层、支撑其余一切”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of fundamental all place something at the base: a need, a principle, a right, a note, or a change that reaches the bottom layer.
sensesIntro.cn: fundamental 的八个义项都把某物放在底层：需求、原则、权利、音符，或触及底层的变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the lowest stone or note bears the weight of everything above it.
core.cn: 核心意象：最底下的石头或音符承载上方一切的重量。

branches.en: INDISPENSABLE: what is at the base cannot be removed without the whole falling.
branches.cn: 不可或缺：底部之物一旦移除，整体就会崩塌。

branches.en: LITERAL AND NATURAL LAW: a physical foundation, and a law from which other results are derived.
branches.cn: 字面基础与自然定律：物理地基，以及其他结果由之推导的定律。

branches.en: THE FUNDAMENTALS: the basic rules and skills that a subject is built on.
branches.cn: 基础原理：学科建立其上的基本规则与技能。

branches.en: MUSIC: the lowest note supports the chord, the same image in sound.
branches.cn: 音乐：最低的音支撑和弦，是同一意象在声音中的体现。

branches.en: RIGHTS AND CHANGE: a right beneath ordinary law, or a change that reaches the base layer.
branches.cn: 权利与变化：位于普通法律之下的权利，或触及底层的变化。

intro.en: Fundamental is an adjective in -al from fundamentum. English adds -ly, -ism, -ist, and keeps the noun fundament.
intro.cn: fundamental 是来自 fundamentum 的 -al 形容词。英语加 -ly、-ism、-ist，并保留名词 fundament。

latinIntro.en: The fundus family includes fundus, fundare, fundatio, fundamentum and fundamentalis. The parallel noun foundation comes through fundatio; fundamental comes through fundamentum, so they are siblings rather than one being derived from the other.
latinIntro.cn: fundus 词族包括 fundus、fundare、fundatio、fundamentum、fundamentalis。名词 foundation 经 fundatio 而来，fundamental 经 fundamentum 而来，因此它们是兄弟，而不是一个由另一个派生。

items.meaning: forming the base; essential
items.meaningCN: 基本的；根本的（fundamentum“基础”+ -al）
items.example: These are fundamental questions.
items.exampleCN: 这些是根本性的问题。

items.meaning: at the deepest level; in essence
items.meaningCN: 根本上；从根本上说（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The system is fundamentally sound.
items.exampleCN: 这个系统从根本上说是健全的。

items.meaning: strict adherence to basic religious principles
items.meaningCN: 原教旨主义；基要主义（-ism 表示主义）
items.example: The movement grew out of religious fundamentalism.
items.exampleCN: 这场运动源于宗教原教旨主义。

items.meaning: a person who holds strict basic principles
items.meaningCN: 原教旨主义者；基要派信徒（-ist 表示支持者）
items.example: A fundamentalist reads the text literally.
items.exampleCN: 原教旨主义者按字面解读文本。

items.meaning: a base; the buttocks
items.meaningCN: 基础；臀部（拉丁 fundamentum 直接借入）
items.example: The fundament of the theory is observation.
items.exampleCN: 该理论的基础是观察。

items.meaning: serving as a foundation
items.meaningCN: 基础的；作为根基的（foundation + -al）
items.example: Reading is a foundational skill.
items.exampleCN: 阅读是一项基础技能。

items.meaning: a base or an endowed institution
items.meaningCN: 地基；基金会（fundatio“创立”+ -ion）
items.example: The foundation of the bridge is deep.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥的地基很深。

items.meaning: money set aside; to finance
items.meaningCN: 基金；资助（拉丁 fundus“底部、土地”）
items.example: They fund the research.
items.exampleCN: 他们资助这项研究。

items.meaning: very deep; intense
items.meaningCN: 深刻的；深远的（pro-“向前”+ fundus“底部”，同根）
items.example: The book had a profound effect.
items.exampleCN: 这本书产生了深远影响。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 底部；基础；土地（fundamental 的最终词源）
基础；地基；支撑（英语 fundament、fundamental 的来源）
基础的；根本的（英语 fundamental 的直接拉丁模型）
铺设底部；建立（英语 found 的来源）
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语例：他给房子打地基。
